construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit H25-026 (Site Development Permit/Amendment, folder year 2025), status Under Review: "Site Development Permit to allow the demolition of three single-family homes for the construction of 20-unit townhome development under State Density Bonus Law on approximately 0.61-gross-acre site."
City of San Jose permit PRE25-280 (Prelim - Focused (Policy Review, No Plans), folder year 2025), status Complete: "SB 330 Preliminary Application for a 21-unit townhome development"

City of San Jose permit T25-020 (Tentative Map, folder year 2025), status Under Review: "Tentative map to replace three single-family homes with a 21-unit townhome development on a 0.61-gross-acre site in the MUN Zoning District."
City permit layer names Amir Moeini (Aria Build & Construction Inc.) as applicant and Aria Build & Construction Inc. as owner on PRE25-280, ER25-151, H25-026 and T25-020.

Earlier proposal on the same parcel: PRE19-011 (filed 2019-01-25, address 531 Page St, applicant Jun Zhang), focused preliminary review for a 44-unit multifamily building with subterranean parking; status Complete.

MLS listing ML81991765 (status Closed, price $1,785,000) marketed two adjacent parcels, 529 Page St and 541 Page St, as one development site; it described 529/533 Page as two single-family homes and 541 Page as four one-bedroom units.
County parcel 277-19-034 lists situs 529 Page St with 3 situs addresses; adjacent parcel 277-19-035 is 541 Page St.
